confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain given July peak-season volatility (Gion Matsuri). Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about double, wine about a third more) because direct price knowledge for them is less certain. FX 0.6955 is relayed from a web search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and is not confirmed against the live table; a cross-check found only a March 2026 RBA snapshot, so verify before use. If the 15 Oct entry is not yet posted, the prior observation is 14 Oct at 0.7002.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; based on general Japanese price levels with a Kyoto tourist premium for lodging and mid-range dining, loosely compared to Osaka and Nara from general knowledge (no live data).
